comment: E9 Phase-5 cross-provider broad eval set. 65 prompts spanning all 31 providers, 12 archetypes (A1-A12), 5 personas (SRE/PE/SecEng/FinOps/JuniorDev). Designed to complement evals/evals.json (50 prompts, AWS/CF heavy) by covering under-represented providers (1password, ansible, auth0, clickhouse, crowdstrike, external, helm, local, netlify, pinecone, random, redis-cloud, splunk, time, tls) with realistic operational language.

evals.title: Snowflake warehouse + database + role
evals.prompt: Spin up a Snowflake warehouse named ANALYTICS_WH (X-SMALL, auto-suspend 60s) with a paired database ANALYTICS_DB and a functional role ANALYTICS_RW that has USAGE on the warehouse and ALL on the database for our analytics team.

evals.title: ClickHouse Cloud service for product analytics
evals.prompt: Provision a ClickHouse Cloud service named 'product-analytics-prod' in AWS us-east-1, development tier, idle scaling enabled. We'll point our event pipeline at it.

evals.title: Pinecone RAG index
evals.prompt: Create a Pinecone serverless index 'rag-docs' in aws us-east-1, 1536 dimensions, cosine metric, for our internal docs RAG bot.

evals.title: 1Password vault item for shared API key
evals.prompt: Store the Stripe restricted API key as a 1Password item in our 'Engineering' vault — type 'login', label 'Stripe Restricted Key (Backend)', so app servers can pull it via the 1Password Connect provider.

evals.title: Helm release: cert-manager on EKS
evals.prompt: Helm-install cert-manager into the cert-manager namespace on our EKS cluster, version 1.16, with the CRDs installed and a values override enabling the prometheus servicemonitor.

evals.title: TLS self-signed cert for internal service
evals.prompt: Generate a 4096-bit RSA private key and a self-signed cert valid 1 year for internal-svc.vegastack.local, SAN includes both internal-svc.vegastack.local and 10.0.5.42.

evals.title: Time-based rotation trigger for IAM access key
evals.prompt: Use the time provider to rotate an IAM access key every 90 days — give me the trigger pattern.

evals.title: Random password for RDS master user
evals.prompt: Generate a random 32-char password (no special chars problematic for shells), and feed it into an aws_db_instance master_password and an aws_secretsmanager_secret_version.

evals.title: Render rendered manifest to local file
evals.prompt: After templating my values, write the rendered output to ./out/values.rendered.yaml on disk so I can inspect before applying.

evals.title: External data source to call a script
evals.prompt: I need to pull the current Git SHA into Terraform variables — use the external provider data source to shell out to `git rev-parse HEAD` and return it as JSON.

evals.title: Ansible inventory host record
evals.prompt: Register a Terraform-provisioned EC2 instance as an Ansible inventory host (group 'app_servers', ansible_user=ec2-user, hostvars include instance_id and private_ip) so our Ansible playbook can find it.

evals.title: Auth0 Action: add custom claim from external API
evals.prompt: Add an Auth0 Action on the post-login flow that calls our internal /entitlements API with the user's email and adds the returned plan tier as a custom claim 'https://vegastack.com/plan' on both id_token and access_token.

evals.title: Okta OIDC app for our SaaS
evals.prompt: Register an Okta OIDC web app for app.vegastack.com — auth code + PKCE, redirect URIs https://app.vegastack.com/callback, post-logout https://app.vegastack.com/, group assignment 'Engineering' and 'Product'.

evals.title: Redis Cloud subscription + DB
evals.prompt: Spin up a Redis Cloud Pro subscription on AWS us-east-1 with a 5GB single-shard database 'sessions-prod' for our session store. Multi-AZ on, persistence aof-every-1-second.

evals.title: Splunk index for app logs
evals.prompt: Create a Splunk index 'app_prod_logs' with 90-day retention and frozen-time path on our cold tier.

evals.title: Netlify DNS record for legacy site
evals.prompt: Add a CNAME on our Netlify-managed zone for blog.vegastack.com pointing to ghost-pages.fly.dev.

evals.title: Vercel project + env vars
evals.prompt: Set up our Next.js app as a Vercel project linked to vegastack/website on the main branch, with NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL set per environment (production/preview/development).

evals.title: DigitalOcean droplet for staging
evals.prompt: Stand up a single s-2vcpu-4gb DigitalOcean droplet in nyc3 named 'staging-bastion' with SSH key and tag 'env:staging'.

evals.title: CrowdStrike dynamic host group for prod EC2
evals.prompt: Create a CrowdStrike Falcon host group 'aws-prod-linux' that dynamically includes any host with platform 'Linux' and the AWS tag env=prod.

evals.title: Args of snowflake_grant_privileges_to_account_role
evals.prompt: What arguments does snowflake_grant_privileges_to_account_role take? Specifically I want to know the on_account_object vs on_schema_object difference.

evals.title: Args of vault_database_secret_backend_role
evals.prompt: What args does vault_database_secret_backend_role accept for a Postgres dynamic-creds setup? I need the creation_statements format.

evals.title: Args of pagerduty_service
evals.prompt: What args does pagerduty_service take, and how do I set the auto-resolve and acknowledgement timeouts?

evals.title: Args of grafana_dashboard
evals.prompt: How do I pass dashboard JSON into grafana_dashboard? Is the config_json arg the only way, or is there a templated alternative?

evals.title: Args of helm_release for chart values
evals.prompt: What args does helm_release accept? I want to know the difference between values, set, and set_sensitive — when should I use each?

evals.title: Import existing Snowflake database
evals.prompt: We have an existing Snowflake database PROD_ANALYTICS that was created in the UI. Give me the import command and a starter resource block.

evals.title: Import existing Okta group
evals.prompt: Bring our existing Okta group 'Engineering' (id 00g1abc23defGHIJ4567) under Terraform.

evals.title: Import a Grafana folder
evals.prompt: We have a Grafana folder 'SLO Dashboards' (uid: slo-dashboards). Bring it under Terraform.

evals.title: Import a Vercel project
evals.prompt: We created our Vercel project in the dashboard. Project id prj_abc123. Bring it under Terraform with the import command and matching block.

evals.title: Import an existing PagerDuty service
evals.prompt: We have an existing PagerDuty service 'web-api' (id PXXXXXX) that someone made in the UI. Bring it into Terraform.

evals.title: Migrate Vault KV v1 mounts to v2
evals.prompt: Our 'secret/' mount is still kv v1. Migrate everything under it to kv v2 — show the new mount, the data path differences, and how to migrate vault_generic_secret to vault_kv_secret_v2.

evals.title: Migrate snowflake_role_grants to v0.93+ split resources
evals.prompt: Our Snowflake provider is on the old grants model with snowflake_grant. Modernize to the per-object grants in 0.93+ — show the renames and which resource to use for account-object vs schema-object grants.

evals.title: Update helm provider v2 → v3 release fields
evals.prompt: Our helm provider is on v2 and we have a few helm_release resources. What changes when we go to v3 — anything I need to fix in our blocks?

evals.title: Migrate kubernetes_deployment → kubernetes_deployment_v1
evals.prompt: Our codebase still uses kubernetes_deployment, kubernetes_service, kubernetes_config_map. Migrate to the recommended _v1 suffixed resources.

evals.title: Spin up an AKS cluster end-to-end
evals.prompt: I need a small AKS cluster for dev — make it usable end-to-end (resource group, networking, node pool, kubeconfig output).

evals.title: Spin up a Cloud Run service end-to-end
evals.prompt: Stand up a Cloud Run service called 'api' on GCP — public, with the artifact registry repo and IAM bindings to make it actually deployable.

evals.title: Pinecone RAG stack with API key
evals.prompt: Set up a Pinecone serverless index for our RAG app along with a service-scoped API key our backend will use.

evals.title: ClickHouse Cloud + private endpoint to AWS VPC
evals.prompt: We need a ClickHouse Cloud service plus a private endpoint reachable from our AWS VPC vpc-0abc12345 — wire the whole thing.

evals.title: Grafana SLO dashboards + alert rule + contact point
evals.prompt: Stand up a Grafana SLO pack: a folder, two dashboards (api + db), an alert rule on burn rate, and a contact point routing to PagerDuty.

evals.title: Snowflake RBAC topology — multi-role hierarchy
evals.prompt: Build a Snowflake RBAC tree for our company: ANALYTICS_RW > ANALYTICS_RO > ANALYST hierarchy, granted on PROD_DB schemas, with three users assigned each.

evals.title: Vault PKI: root + intermediate + role
evals.prompt: Build a Vault PKI hierarchy: a self-signed root (10y), an intermediate signed by it (3y), and a role 'webcerts' issuing certs valid 30 days for *.vegastack.internal.

evals.title: GitLab project bootstrap with protected branches
evals.prompt: Bootstrap a new GitLab project 'platform/iac' under our 'platform' group: protected main branch (require MR + 2 approvals), CI/CD vars for AWS_ROLE_ARN, default merge method 'rebase'.

evals.title: Cloudflare Worker + D1 + R2 stack
evals.prompt: Deploy an edge worker that reads from a D1 database and writes uploaded blobs to an R2 bucket — give me the full Cloudflare topology.

evals.title: Datadog AWS integration end-to-end
evals.prompt: Wire up the Datadog–AWS integration: the IAM role Datadog assumes, the integration_aws record, and a baseline dashboard for EC2 host counts.

evals.title: cert-manager on EKS + Route53 dns01 + Let's Encrypt wildcard
evals.prompt: Helm-install cert-manager on our EKS cluster, configure a ClusterIssuer using Let's Encrypt with Route53 dns01 solver scoped to vegastack.com, and pre-create the IRSA role + policy needed for the Route53 access.

evals.title: Vault dynamic Postgres creds for app on K8s
evals.prompt: Wire dynamic Postgres credentials from Vault to our app pod on EKS: vault database secret backend connection, role with creation_statements, and a Kubernetes auth role bound to the 'web' service account.

evals.title: Pinecone API key in 1Password, synced via Vault
evals.prompt: Provision a Pinecone API key, store it in 1Password as the source of truth, and write a Vault KV v2 secret that reads it for our backend service to consume.

evals.title: Generate cert with TLS provider, import to ACM, validate via Cloudflare DNS
evals.prompt: Issue a wildcard cert (*.vegastack.com) using the TLS provider, import it into AWS ACM, and add the Cloudflare DNS validation records — fully automated.

evals.title: Random password → AWS Secrets Manager → RDS master password
evals.prompt: Generate the RDS master password with the random provider, store it in AWS Secrets Manager, and configure rotation through the secretsmanager rotation lambda.

evals.title: Vercel project + Netlify legacy redirect + Cloudflare Worker for AB test
evals.prompt: We're moving from Netlify to Vercel — keep Netlify for legacy /blog/* redirects and put a Cloudflare Worker out front for an AB test routing 10% of root traffic to the old site.

evals.title: CrowdStrike sensor coverage on every EC2 in org
evals.prompt: Make sure every EC2 in our AWS org runs the CrowdStrike Falcon sensor — register the AWS account with Falcon Cloud Security, set up an SSM association to install the sensor, and an SCP-style enforcement.

evals.title: Migrate Splunk → OpenTelemetry collector → Datadog backend
evals.prompt: We're moving off Splunk: keep the Splunk index up for 30-day cutover, deploy an OTel collector on our EKS cluster sending to Datadog, and create the Datadog logs index.

evals.title: Ansible inventory from EC2, code in GitLab + secrets in GitHub
evals.prompt: We provision EC2 with Terraform, register them as Ansible hosts, store the playbooks in GitLab, and need a GitHub Actions secret with the SSH key for the runners.

evals.title: Auth0 Action calls our API for custom claims
evals.prompt: Wire an Auth0 Action that calls our /entitlements API at api.vegastack.com on post-login, adds the returned plan tier as a custom claim, and stores the API token as a Vault KV v2 secret the action reads.

evals.title: Redis Cloud + ElastiCache failover + Mongo Atlas backup verify
evals.prompt: Multi-tier data layer: Redis Cloud Pro DB primary, ElastiCache Redis as warm standby in our VPC, and a MongoDB Atlas advanced cluster with continuous backups and a snapshot policy.

evals.title: GitLab CI plan/apply with state in Terraform Cloud
evals.prompt: Set up a GitLab CI pipeline that runs terraform plan on MR and apply on main, with state stored in Terraform Cloud — the GitLab project, the CI vars (TFE_TOKEN), and the Terraform-side cloud {} block.

evals.title: Snowflake warehouse + Datadog query-latency monitor
evals.prompt: Spin up a Snowflake warehouse for analytics and a Datadog monitor that pages on average query latency above 30s for 15 minutes.

evals.title: DigitalOcean App Platform + Cloudflare DNS + Datadog uptime
evals.prompt: Run our small side-project on DigitalOcean App Platform with a custom domain pointed via Cloudflare DNS, and a Datadog synthetic uptime check from 3 regions.

evals.title: Snowflake network policy lock-down
evals.prompt: Lock down Snowflake account access to our office IPs and our AWS NAT gateway IPs with a network policy applied at account level — the policy and the account-level binding.

evals.title: Okta MFA enforcement policy
evals.prompt: Enforce MFA for everyone in the 'Engineering' Okta group with WebAuthn or Okta Verify push only — sign-on policy + rule.

evals.title: GitHub repo branch protection for SOC2
evals.prompt: Lock down our 'vegastack/infra' main branch: required reviews=2, required CI checks (terraform plan, tflint), no force pushes, no deletions, signed commits required.

evals.title: GCP org policy: require CMEK on storage buckets
evals.prompt: Enforce a GCP org policy that all new google_storage_bucket must use CMEK encryption (constraints/storage.uniformBucketLevelAccess + constraint that disallows default encryption).

evals.title: Cut Snowflake compute spend
evals.prompt: Our Snowflake bill is dominated by an XLARGE warehouse running 24/7. Cut the cost roughly 60% — what changes (size, auto_suspend, auto_resume, multi-cluster, resource monitor) should we make in Terraform?

evals.title: Right-size MongoDB Atlas cluster
evals.prompt: Our prod Atlas cluster is M40 multi-region but utilization is 12%. Cut the bill in half — instance size, region count, autoscaling — keep it at M-tier dedicated.

evals.title: Move Redis Cloud Pro → Essentials
evals.prompt: Our Redis Cloud Pro subscription is overkill — 50MB used of 5GB. Move us to Essentials free tier or near-free fixed-plan, keep the same key namespace.

evals.title: Cut Vercel bandwidth spend with edge cache
evals.prompt: Vercel Bandwidth charges are spiking. We push lots of static assets — the Terraform-side changes (project settings, edge cache headers, image optimization) to reduce egress.

evals.title: GitLab CI plan/apply with TFC backend
evals.prompt: Build the GitLab CI pipeline (project, protected main, CI vars TFE_TOKEN/AWS_ROLE_ARN, .gitlab-ci.yml committed via terraform_data) for plan-on-MR / apply-on-main with state in Terraform Cloud.

evals.title: GitHub Actions deploy pipeline → Vercel
evals.prompt: Build a GH Actions deploy pipeline for our Vercel app: env-scoped secrets, workflow triggers on main push, and a vercel_project_environment_variable for VERCEL_ORG_ID + VERCEL_PROJECT_ID.

evals.title: Bootstrap ArgoCD via helm_release
evals.prompt: Helm-install ArgoCD into the argocd namespace on our EKS cluster, with values overrides enabling the SSO integration via Okta and ingress through the AWS Load Balancer Controller.

evals.title: Rotate Okta app client_secret
evals.prompt: We need to rotate the client_secret on our Okta OIDC app 'app.vegastack.com' without dropping live sessions — the Terraform-side change and operational order.

evals.title: Suspend/resume Snowflake warehouse off-hours
evals.prompt: Add an automatic suspend/resume schedule to our ANALYTICS_WH warehouse — suspend nights 8pm-6am ET via auto_suspend, and a resource monitor that triggers at 80% of monthly credit cap.

evals.title: Schedule a PagerDuty maintenance window
evals.prompt: Schedule a 2-hour PagerDuty maintenance window starting Saturday 2am UTC for our 'web-api' service so we can do the Postgres major-version upgrade without paging.

evals.title: What changed in helm provider v3?
evals.prompt: Helm provider v3 came out — what changed that I need to know about? Anything deprecated in helm_release?

evals.title: Is mongodbatlas_cluster being deprecated?
evals.prompt: I see warnings about mongodbatlas_cluster — what's replacing it and when do I need to migrate?

evals.title: Should I still use google_cloud_run_service?
evals.prompt: We're starting a new GCP service — should I use google_cloud_run_service or google_cloud_run_v2_service? Which is recommended now?

evals.title: Azure Key Vault + access policy + secret
evals.prompt: Stand up an Azure Key Vault in eastus2 for our prod app secrets, with an access policy granting our app's user-assigned managed identity get/list on secrets, and an initial secret 'db-password'.

evals.title: Old datadog_monitor query format still works?
evals.prompt: Our older datadog_monitor resources use host: scoping in the query for our Lambda functions and aren't firing. What's the new syntax?
